title: Etale pullback computes the higher conormal sheaf of an immersion of algebraic spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For an immersion Z -> X of algebraic spaces and an etale morphism U -> X with U a scheme, the lemma identifies the higher conormal sheaf C_{Z/X,*} restricted to Z_U with the higher conormal sheaf C_{Z_U/U}, canonically and functorially in U. The proof is a written reduction: choose a closed subspace T whose complement carries the immersion, take the defining quasi-coherent ideal I on X minus T, and observe that the restriction of I to U minus the preimage of T is the ideal sheaf of the induced immersion, which is clear from the construction of the ideal in the closed-immersion lemma. Retained author proof at lines 691-701.
